'''Rind jam''' is the preservation of the [[melon]]. It heals {{Hp|4}} and grants {{EffectLink|Fire Resistance}} for 5 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/rind_jam.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A raw melon slice, sugar and a glass bottle. Picking up a melon slice unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating rind jam takes 1.6 seconds, heals {{Hp|4}} and gives Fire Resistance for 5:00. It gives the glass bottle back when eaten.
